Redialling (2025-07-25)

I am redesigning this website to represent me more, originally wanted a subtle gradient background but the sizing wouldn't budge and so I settled with this darkish-green-almost-black background for the dark theme of the website. The background on the light theme of the site remains unchanged for legibility. Additionally, I changed the font from using either your device's built-in sans-serif font or Inter if it's installed to IBM Plex Sans since it is the font I daily drive on my system.

11 days ago, I hit the 1 year mark of being on estrogen. I started taking it knowing full well I would need to maintain my hormone levels so that my transition would work effectively. My transitioning is taking a toll financially, but this is my responsibility to be who I wanna be and be emotionally connected with my true self.

A week before that, I had my ears pierced. They picked out silver studs which isn't my style frankly, but I do find them to look nice and pretty on me.
